assertions.exact_command: Android: adb -s <ANDROID_SERIAL> shell am instrument -w -r -e class top.onethinker.yunjian.FullAcceptanceTest top.onethinker.yunjian.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner；iOS: xcodebuild test-without-building -xctestrun <YUNJIAN_XCTESTRUN> -destination 'platform=iOS,id=<IOS_UDID>' -resultBundlePath <YUNJIAN_RESULT_BUNDLE>
